a_before_b.rationale: Defining full finetuning as training all model parameters does not require first distinguishing between information-based and behavior-based failures or deciding between RAG and finetuning.

b_before_a.rationale: Understanding when to apply RAG versus finetuning does not require knowing the specific definition of full finetuning, as the decision can be made at a conceptual level without parameter-level details.
